newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NEDLLOYD, DUTCH STATE IN EFFICIENCY PROJECT.
newsitem.headline: NEDLLOYD, DUTCH STATE IN EFFICIENCY PROJECT.

text.p: The Dutch ministry of Transport said on Wednesday it had signed a letter of intent with transport firm Koninklijke Nedlloyd NV to jointly set up a project aimed at improving the efficiency of transport.

Several units of Nedlloyd will be involved in the project which should reduce the number of kilometers driven by Nedlloyd's trucks and vans, cutting the emission of harmful gasses such as carbon dioxide and nitrogen oxides.
The letter of intent includes an inventory of Nedlloyd units where the number of kilometres can be cut and energy saved.
The ministry said Nedlloyd and it aimed to turn the project into a long term agreement, to be finalised at a later date, which details the goals, execution, duration and way of financing.
"Realising efficiency improvements will give Nedlloyd both competitive advantages and a reduction of harmful environmental effects," the ministry said in a statement.
